---
name: Feature Request
about: Request new fixtures, carriers, or documentation
title: "[REQUEST] "
labels: enhancement
---

## What's needed?

- [ ] New carrier (e.g., tracking fixtures for [carrier])
- [ ] New event type (e.g., order **cancelled** webhook)
- [ ] New scenario for existing event (e.g., FedEx delivery exception)
- [ ] Better documentation
- [ ] Other:

## Details

What fixture or documentation would help you integrate with ShipStation?

For fixtures, include:
- Which event/resource (orders, labels, fulfillments, tracking)
- Which carrier (if applicable: FedEx, UPS, USPS)
- Which scenario/status (e.g., delivered, exception, cancelled)

## Can you contribute?

If you have access to real production data and can capture and sanitize a fixture, check `CONTRIBUTING.md` and open a PR. Otherwise, this issue helps the maintainers prioritize.
